summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a material change report on Form 6-K regarding a private placement of 4.125% convertible senior notes due 2031 for up to US$275 million aggregate principal. The offering comprised a US$225 million base offering to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and a US$50 million non-brokered private placement, with an underwriter option for an additional US$25 million fully exercised. The notes are general senior unsecured obligations, convertible at holders' option into cash, common shares, or a combination at an initial conversion price of ~US$3.68 per share, representing a 25% premium to the prior closing. Net proceeds of ~US$290 million after discounts and expenses will fund capped call transaction costs (~US$40.2 million), development of the Cariboo Gold Project, and general corporate purposes. The base offering closed May 26, 2026, and the private placement and option exercise closed May 29, 2026. This is a capital-raising debt issuance, not a special-situation event; watch for share dilution upon conversion and project development execution.
